detail: JSA Advocates & Solicitors has announced the addition of Ruchi Diwakar as Retained Partner in its Mumbai office, strengthening the firm’s capabilities across real estate transactions and financing. Diwakar is a 2006 alumnus of National Law Institute University, Bhopal. She has nearly two decades of experience advising developers, corporate houses, funds, financial institutions and high-net-worth clients on a broad range of real estate transactions and real estate financing matters.
